data: MDRRMD's own fire and flood records (given 2026-11-04): fires December 2024 to October 2026, floods June 2025 to October 2026, each with its GPS point; rainfall from ERA5 (Open-Meteo) as the live feed reads it; signals from news and storm tracks. Floods are logged in the rainy months only. See docs/OBJECTIVE-2-RESULTS.md
